cr-api:
import requests

page = 1
total = 0
while True:
    data = requests.get('http://nexus.local/api/products', params={'page': page}).json()
    total += sum(p['stock'] for p in data['items'])
    if not data['has_next']:
        break
    page += 1
print(total)
